newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on grains spillover.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply higher on grains spillover.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply higher Monday, mostly in response to limit gains in CBOT corn futures, floor traders said.
"Mostly we were seeing carryover (strength) from the other markets," one floor trader said.
CBOT corn and soybean markets rallied to daily trading limits on Monday on concerns that recent dry weather and forecasts for more of the same could damage the new crops.
The rice rally was also linked to technical strength by some floor traders.
"There was virtually no selling for the first hour of trade," said one floor trader.
One trader noted that sell orders were linked to hedge activity when September rice reached $9.70 per cwt.
Rice ended 15 to 20 cents per cwt higher with August up 19 at $9.65. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 500 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 685 lots.
